metrics.core_area_status: not_reportable_without full photonic routing, thermal structures, SRAM macros, and post-layout extraction
metrics.recommended_reporting_case: report nominal lower bound together with lock-aware 1% sensitivity

photodiode.source: Lischke et al., Ultra-fast germanium photodiode with 3-dB bandwidth of 265 GHz, Nature Photonics 15, 925-931 (2021)
photodiode.material: waveguide-coupled epitaxial Ge p-i-n on silicon
photodiode.adoption_note: The analytical screen uses the reported 0.45 A/W upper representative responsivity and 0.20 uA dark-current bound; the 5 GHz analysis bandwidth is an architecture-level operating choice below the demonstrated detector bandwidth.

tia.source: Declercq et al., A 64-GHz Optical Receiver for 128-GBd Links Using a 55-nm SiGe BiCMOS Traveling-Wave Linear TIA, Journal of Lightwave Technology 43, 4139-4148 (2025)
tia.adoption_note: The 18.8 pA/sqrt(Hz) value anchors the TIA noise density. HIPSA's 200 ohm value is a low-gain aggregate-current operating point selected to keep the official G=4 operating point within the 0.8 V analog/ADC range; it is not claimed as the cited receiver's gain.

mrr_weight_bank.source: Zhu et al., Lightening-Transformer, HPCA 2024, Table III
mrr_weight_bank.adoption_note: Strongly related architecture-level MRR anchor. HIPSA topology remains its own four 64x64 signed-differential tiles.

bound_derivation.physical_rule: spatial same-neuron partial sums must be simultaneously available; G divides and cannot exceed N_physical_tiles; no temporal analog storage

device_budget_audit.literature_source: Zhu et al., Lightening-Transformer, HPCA 2024, Table III
device_budget_audit.note: No arbitrary lock budget is selected as the headline. The sensitivity exposes 0/1/5/10/100% simultaneously locked fractions; a real controller and thermal-domain extraction are still required.

mrr_stabilization.distinction: Continuous stabilization power is separate from one-shot MRR configuration energy.

input_encoding.note: CIFAR clipped-count histogram is absent; the 3-pulse bound is used for the headline rather than treating the first layer as binary.

publication_ready_reason: An open-45nm standard-cell area anchor is present, but hardware-aware accuracy, post-route timing/power, SRAM macros, and photonic extraction remain unavailable; software speedup baselines are intentionally omitted.
